answer: Cloning N identities costs N verified locations plus forfeitable stake, so attackers pay linearly while honest agents pay once. Agents stake bond on a shared terrace ledger, but each identity must also anchor to a distinct physical knoll verified by local witnesses; a sybil farm on one island cannot fake scattered geography. Duplicate knoll proofs slash the bond, making mass fakery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0040 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
